snippet.title: Shinobi - NeoGeo port - Gameplay Preview
snippet.description:
NeoGeo port of Sega System16 Arcade Shinobi

Recorded from NeoGeo CD system, running from physical CD.

Coming to NeoGeo CD/MVS/AES very soon.
